rules.applicability: Creature not wearing armor and with no other applicable AC calculation
rules: Alternate AC calculations replace rather than stack.
Explicit AC bonuses apply after selecting the calculation.
Qi Armor is a conditional bonus and does not replace this calculation.

rules.applicability: All creatures using the ordinary initiative check
rules: Advantage and Disadvantage use the ordinary check mechanism.
Street-Hardened grants situational Advantage under its authenticated trigger.

scope: Universal baseline rules only; not a recovered quotation from the prior corpus.
